summary: Replaced the legacy app_code-scoped RBAC system with a shared, single-app 'accessrbac' core used identically by myidsan and myseliasan. The new core stores roles (access_role) and a per-endpoint permission matrix (access_role_permission) in each app's own database, with no app_code dimension. A superadmin role flag bypasses the matrix entirely; all other roles are governed by longest-prefix path matching per HTTP verb. Built-in 'superadmin' and 'viewer' roles are seeded on startup. The shared management surface is GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/access-rbac/roles and GET/POST/DELETE /api/access-rbac/permissions (superadmin-only), plus GET /api/access-rbac/me (auth-only, returns userId, email, roleId, roleName, isSuperadmin, mustChangePassword, and permissions so SPAs can derive menu visibility from the same rules that gate the APIs). All shared admin APIs and app-local admin APIs are now enforced by AccessSessionMidware (disabled/must-change-password gate + matrix check). myseliasan gained its own user store (control_user: local stock superadmin + federated myidsan users) with a revised bootstrap handoff (POST /api/rbac/users/{id}/elevate grants superadmin but no longer auto-retires the stock account; a persistent SPA banner prompts manual disable once safe; a lockout guard blocks disabling the stock account until a real superadmin is active). SuperadminStatus (stockActive, realActive) is exposed on session/me and drives the banner. The parent-to-node reverse command tunnel was also added: a ControlServer on the parent (port pairing.controlPort, default 49533) accepts node-dialed fleet-mTLS WebSocket connections; /api/nodes/{id}/proxy/<node-path> on myseliasan forwards tunneled commands to the node's own API router; per-node read/write access grants (node_access_grant) gate the proxy. mymatasan received the node-side ControlDispatcher. Node-pushed events are ingested into the control plane's unified notification feed. myidsan gained: config-driven stock superadmin bootstrap (EnsureStockSuperadmin from localAuth.username/password, MustChangePassword forced first-login gate + ChangePasswordScreen in the SPA); authenticated POST /api/login/default/change-password; SSO certificate authority (GET /api/sso-ca, POST /api/sso-ca/issue/{id}, SsoCa entity, ISsoCaService backed by infra/fleetca); GET /api/identity-status (handoff banner driver); app-local endpoint catalog (cross-app rows deleted on startup); built-in app code self-healing; GET /api/access-rbac/me now returns userId and email. Frontend standardization: both SPAs use the dark icon side-nav (SideNav) with grouped Administration section (Users/Roles/RBAC), icon glyphs, and a light/dark theme toggle. myidsan rebuilt Users page as inline admin and Apps page as master-detail with SSO cert issuance; Roles page now manages accessrbac roles directly. myseliasan split RbacAdminTab into separate UsersPage/RolesPage/RbacPage using shared DataTable.
compatibility: Breaking for the RBAC admin surface: the legacy /api/endpoint-rbac route group and POST /api/sso/authorize are removed; operators must migrate role/permission configuration to /api/access-rbac. The access_role and access_role_permission tables are auto-created by bootstrap on first run. myidsan: the hardcoded SQL superadmin seed is replaced by EnsureStockSuperadmin; add a 'localAuth' block to config.json (username, password) before first run — defaults are 'admin'/'admin123'. The MustChangePassword column is new on user_login (add-only migration; existing rows default to false). myseliasan: localAuth.password default changed from 'admin' to 'admin123' in config.json. The stock superadmin is no longer auto-retired on handoff; operators must manually disable it from the Users list. mymatasan is unaffected (local Basic Auth, opts out of accessrbac). The pairing.controlPort config key is new and defaults to 49533; no action needed for existing pairings. mTLS enforcement on the myidsan token endpoint is not yet implemented.
